name: Electron Cash 4.4.6 with CashFusion, CashTokens, and RPA
body:
This new release of Electron Cash contains a **very important update** to the Tor binary that is packaged with the app. Tor is undergoing a network upgrade and as of Sept. 1, 2026, the older 0.4.8 tor binary that Electron Cash was using [**will no longer be supported by the tor network**](https://blog.torproject.org/sunsetting-tor-048/), and as such, **CashFusion would fail**.  

This release contains the **new** 0.4.9 series binary (so it will continue to work ok). 

It is *highly recommended* that all users of Electron Cash upgrade to this release, if they make use of the integrated tor proxy and/or if they make use of CashFusion.

- Fix for crash when using RPA wallets (cculianu)
- Remove fixed value from network dust error (The00Dustin)
- transaction.py: Fix for input fetcher rare crash (cculianu)
- Fixup to caches.py, also expand the limit on the input fetcher tx cache (cculianu)
- android: optionally set python in local.properties (Jonas Lundqvist)
- android: replace testnet4 with chipnet (Jonas Lundqvist)
- android: fix NPE in ListFragment on process restore (Jonas Lundqvist)
- various build fixes for WINE version (cculianu, Axel Gembe)
- **build: update tor to version 0.4.9.11 -- necessary after Sept. 1 (Axel Gembe)**
- Handle race condition in util.make_dir (Jonas Lundqvist)
- Fix for libzbar not building on newer macOS (cculianu)
- Various other macOS related build fixes (cculianu)

---

body:
This is bugfix release of Electron Cash. It contains a highly recommended fix for a bad interactions between CashToken-containing UTXOs and CashFusion.  Your tokens are safe, they cannot be burned -- however in some cases CashFusion would "see" CashToken-containing UTXOs and submit them for fusions. They would fail to be signed correctly, of course, so nothing could be lost, but it could lead to a potential situation of many failed fusions. This has been fixed!  Additionally, a performance fix was added such that opening wallets is faster now than in 4.3.0.  As such, it is **highly recommended** that all users of Electron Cash 4.3.0 upgrade as soon as possible to this release!

# What's New in 4.3.1

- Added a performance fix for a situation which led to pessimization/slowdown when opening wallets in some cases (cculianu)
